name: video_eval_v1
description: Frozen video evaluation prompt set for prompt-adherence and technical quality measurement (v0.3 P0). Prompts map onto VBench custom_input technical dimensions plus a manual/LLM prompt-adherence rubric. Deterministic: fixed seed, resolution, and frame count per entry so base-vs-LoRA comparisons isolate the adapter.

guidance.notes: H3 官方权重做过 guidance distillation，同 prompt + 同 seed 下 scale 0 与 scale 1 各跑一次才能隔离 LoRA 效果；每条条目都成对生成。

dimension_semantic_note: semantic 类 9 维（action/object/color/spatial/character/number/style/special_relationship/human_interaction）需 VBench 标准 prompt 集 + detectron2，与本项目无冲突，但需独立 venv。
prompt_adherence_rubric: 1. 每条条目生成 base(scale=0) 与 lora(scale=1) 两个视频，同 seed 同分辨率同帧数。
2. 人工或 MLLM 评分员对 expected_attributes 逐条 0/1 打分，blind、左右随机。
3. 报告 adherence rate = 属性命中数 / 属性总数，并报告 Krippendorff alpha。
4. 同批跑 VBench 6 维技术质量，与 adherence rate 一起作为回归证据。

prompts.prompt: A young woman with short black hair wearing a red wool coat walks through a snowy park toward the camera.
A bald man in a navy suit sits at a wooden desk and signs a document with a fountain pen.
A slow pan across a cobblestone alley in an old European town at dusk, street lamps just turning on.
Inside a bright modern kitchen with white cabinets, a window shows a green garden outside.
A red sports car drives along a coastal road, camera follows from behind in a smooth tracking shot.
A golden retriever runs across a grassy field, camera follows alongside in slow motion.
A surfer rides a large wave, crouching low and carving the board through the water.
Fireworks explode in the night sky above a city skyline, colorful bursts in sequence.
A hand-painted watercolor animation of a small village on a hillside, soft pastel colors, gentle wind.
A cinematic close-up of a cup of black coffee on a marble counter, shallow depth of field, warm morning light.
A film-noir scene in a dimly lit bar, high contrast black-and-white, cigarette smoke drifting.
A silver wristwatch rotates slowly on a black pedestal, studio lighting, clean dark background.
